narr: A slow moving cold front triggered scattered thunderstorms across northern New Hampshire on July 6th. Repeating storms across Grafton and Coos Counties produced locally heavy rainfall resulting in localized areas of road washouts.
ev: Washout on Kimball Hill Road in Whitefield following heavy rainfall estimated around 2.5 inches.
Washout on Walker Hill Road between Presby and Nihan Roads after the Whipple Brook came out of banks in Sugar Hill.
